question: Four letter-pairs have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.
solution:
**Explanation:**

The positional values of the English alphabet is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0feadec6334417d48300e8b565d1c1d9e73015cad02726ea6b55b6976b18ed05.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42d05c8b1af34bfe72a7b27ba866392f87ce64032b418922fd3f5c9957972be7.png] 

Thus, **U-Z was different from the rest**.

**Hence, 'option 2' is the correct answer.**
